name: Orca server
description: Installs Orca (orca-ide) and serves it on your tailnet at container start.

version.description: Orca release to install. The default, 1.4.271, is the tested version. The value latest is not tested.

pairingAddress.description: Address in the pairing link. Empty means the Tailscale DNS name. When set, the entrypoint does not wait for or call Tailscale.

port.description: TCP port Orca listens on, 1 to 65535.

mobilePairing.description: Serve Orca with mobile pairing enabled.

autoStart.description: Start Orca in the background at container start.

showPairingOnAttach.description: Print the pairing link and the mobile QR code in the terminal at each attach. Set false when attach output is logged.

tailscaleWaitSeconds.description: Seconds to wait for Tailscale to report Running before the start fails. 0 means one check.

debSha256.description: Expected SHA-256 of the .deb. Keep the default for the default version. For another version, leave it as is to use the release digest.
